title: Static Gradient Attribution Underperforms a Density-Matched Random Mask on Loss-Based Forgetting Within LoRA B-Matrix
abstract: arXiv:2610.12744v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Parameter-efficient continual learning updates a restricted subset of adapter parameters to incorporate sequential tasks while limiting catastrophic forgetting. Gradient attribution is a common rule for selecting that subset, but it requires an additional backward pass over calibration data. We identify a parameter-pool confound in comparisons between initialization-time gradient masks and unrestricted random masks under standard zero-initialized LoRA ($B=0$): the gradient with respect to $A$ is identically zero ($\partial\mathcal{L}/\partial A=0$), so gradient masks select strictly from the $B$ matrix whereas unrestricted random masks draw from both $A$ and $B$. Such a comparison changes both the selection rule and the candidate parameter pool. Isolating the selection criterion by restricting both approaches to the same parameter pool, we find a negative result: a uniform random mask consistently achieves lower loss-based backward trans

translated_title: 静态梯度归因在LoRA B矩阵内的基于损失的遗忘上表现不如密度匹配的随机掩码
translated_abstract: 参数高效持续学习通过更新受限的适配器参数子集来纳入顺序任务，同时限制灾难性遗忘。梯度归因是选择该子集的常见规则，但它需要对校准数据进行一次额外的反向传播。我们在标准零初始化LoRA（B=0）下，识别出初始化时的梯度掩码与无限制随机掩码之间比较中的一个参数池混淆因素：关于A的梯度恒为零（∂L/∂A=0），因此梯度掩码严格地从B矩阵中选择，而无限制随机掩码则同时从A和B中抽取。这样的比较同时改变了选择规则和候选参数池。通过将两种方法限制在相同的参数池内来隔离选择标准，我们发现了一个负面结果：均匀随机掩码在基于损失的后向迁移（遗忘）上始终实现更低的数值……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究揭示了梯度掩码与随机掩码比较中存在的参数池混淆问题（零初始化LoRA下A的梯度为零），并发现即使限定在同一B矩阵参数池内进行公平比较，密度匹配的均匀随机掩码在基于损失的遗忘指标上仍始终优于静态梯度归因。
en_tdlr: The paper identifies a parameter-pool confound in mask comparisons under zero-initialized LoRA and shows that, when both methods are restricted to the same B-matrix pool, a density-matched uniform random mask consistently outperforms static gradient attribution on loss-based forgetting.
